After all c03-c07 terminal audits PASS, retain TP4 APC session as the internal reference and select DSpark3 as the informative competitor: matched replay C8 is .37472/.38124 versus TP4 .29774/.30257 session/s; matched Agent C6 strict successes are 4/12 twice, quality-qualified throughput .10860/.10591 versus TP4 .06505/.04156 task/s. PP replay is near TP4; DP sticky improves replay to .26841/.26991 but real task throughput has no consistent affinity benefit. This is a scenario-specific next experiment, not a global winner or quality-equivalence claim. For each workload, preregister .15/.30/.60 session/s at 120 seconds and one seed: a low-load latency point, a rate around the observed closed-concurrency range, and a bounded upper probe. Closed throughput is only rate-selection evidence. Screen windows cannot certify capacity. Keep exact arrivals and assigned tasks/replay tokens matched across candidates; actual dynamic calls/output/grades remain measured outcomes. Warm up three replay shapes or all six real tool tasks according to the measured kind, excluded from measurements; reset APC at each phase boundary. No runtime, tool, fixture, grader, GPU scope, global protocol or SLO changes. All outcomes including timeout, budget, censoring or growing queues must be retained. Later confirmation rates/durations will be chosen from terminal open evidence under frozen finite-session-v1, without replacing unfavorable seeds.

Both matched 120-second replay screens are terminal and independently audited. At .30/.60 session/s both TP4 and DSpark show GROWING_BACKLOG trend under the frozen rule, despite DSpark's lower P95 and shorter drains. TP4 .30 has A/C=26/23 and outstanding increase4.328; DSpark .30 has26/21 and increase4.754. At .60 these are50/13 and21.638 versus50/24 and19.372. A single burst-sensitive short trace does not establish long-term capacity. Preregister .20 and .30 session/s,300 seconds,two different seeds202611640/641 for both unchanged deployments: .20 is a conservative candidate below the observed growth point; .30 tests whether the boundary signal persists with a longer and independently sampled arrival window. All started confirmation windows must count under finite-session-v1, including inconclusive/unhealthy ones; do not replace seeds or modify thresholds. This pair answers a concrete lower-point versus boundary hypothesis, not a broad parameter grid. Use terminal audited c10/c11 real Agent screens, not replay capacity or closed concurrency. At .30/.60 session/s TP4 has INCONCLUSIVE trends (A/C26/20 and50/34; outstanding increase3.771/7.885 but not strict three-bin monotonic growth), while DSpark has GROWING_BACKLOG at.30 (26/23,increase3.244) and INCONCLUSIVE at.60 (50/44,increase-.653). These short-window outcomes are nonmonotonic and cannot certify capacity. DSpark nevertheless has lower user-visible P95 at matched .30/.60:22.118/36.717s versus TP452.80/81.64s, shorter drains8.442/19.268s versus37.599/55.388s, and the same strict12/35 and22/65 successes in these specific cohorts.
